title: Sinkhorn AutoEncoders
tldr_zh: 在 WAE 框架内用 Sinkhorn 散度做 latent 匹配，证明 W_p 惩罚给出原目标上界，γ 是解码器 Lipschitz 常数
tldr_en: Uses Sinkhorn divergence for latent matching in WAE; proves W_p penalty upper-bounds the OT objective with γ as decoder Lipschitz constant

key_numbers.context: SAE FID on MNIST with Gaussian / hyperspherical prior
SAE FID on CelebA with Gaussian / hyperspherical prior
HAE FID on CelebA with Gaussian / hyperspherical prior

key_numbers.number: O(M³) Hungarian vs near O(M²) Sinkhorn
O(M^{-1/k}) sample complexity for exact W_p
key_numbers.context: k is latent dimension, citing Weed & Bach 2017

key_numbers.number: O(ε log(1/ε)) deviation from W_c for small ε
key_numbers.context: Sinkhorn divergence bias, citing Genevay et al. 2019
